browse_api.description:
Barbra Streisand – My Name Is Barbra, Two…

Vintage 1965 U.S. Columbia Records MONO LP, catalog CL 2409.

The follow-up to Streisand's My Name Is Barbra, this album accompanied her second television special and became another major commercial success, reaching #2 on the Billboard album chart.

Includes:

  • He Touched Me
  • The Shadow of Your Smile
  • Quiet Night
  • I Got Plenty of Nothin'
  • Second Hand Rose
  • The Kind of Man a Woman Needs
  • All That I Want
  • Where's That Rainbow?
  • No More Songs for Me
  • Medley
  • The Best Things in Life Are Free
